band_rule: paper 0.90 +/- 2 binomial SE on 50 cases (SE = sqrt(0.9*0.1/50) = 0.0424; +/-2SE = [0.8151, 0.9849]), on the 1/50 success grid: 41..49 successes, i.e. [0.82, 0.98] inclusive

paper.source: Zhou, Pan, LeCun, Pinto, DINO-WM, ICML 2025, arXiv 2411.04983v2, Table 1 (PushT SR, 'Ours') = Table 8 row 'MPC'

pass_rule: pass iff the run's final_eval success_rate lies in [0.82, 0.98] (inclusive). At most two logged repair attempts, each fixing a diagnosed port/infrastructure defect, never the band (P-fid); then drop with fidelity_not_reproduced.

protocol.max_iter_reason: the released config sets planner.max_iter null ('unlimited if null'): the MPC loop only ends when all 50 cases succeed, so the paper's 0.90 cannot be the end state of an uncapped run (upstream issue #29: 'very large / infinite cap'). We cap MPC at 12 iterations = 300 env steps (12 x 5 planning steps x frameskip 5), the official gym registration's max_episode_steps=300 for 'pusht' (env/__init__.py). Frozen before the run; never changed after it.
protocol.planner: MPC-CEM: sub_planner CEM horizon 5, num_samples 300, topk 30, opt_steps 30, var_scale 1; n_taken_actions 5

statistic: final_eval/success_rate of the official plan.py (sticky per case: a case counts as solved at the first MPC iteration whose env rollout meets PushT eval_state: position error < 20 and angle error < pi/9)
